Also grepped for '^  def ', '^def ', and lines ending 'do$': zero occurrences. §3.1 now presents Letflow.Simulation.Scenario as a markdown field table (id, company_id, process_id, actors, preconditions, steps, expected_outcomes) plus three sub-shape tables (step(), precondition(), expected_outcome()); §3.2 presents Letflow.Simulation.RunReport the same way (scenario_id, precondition_results, step_results, outcome_results) plus step_result()/outcome_result() sub-shape tables. Spot-checked field content against §3.3's execution algorithm text for internal consistency (not against the original defmodule blocks, which no longer exist in the file, but against the surrounding prose that described the same fields pre-rework per the FAIL handoff's own quotes) -- e.g. precondition.check's three values (:process_definition_active/:no_pending_instances/:custom) match §3.3 step 1's three checks verbatim; step_result.outcome's three values (:ok/:error/:deferred_to_s8) match §3.3 steps 2-3; outcome_result.outcome (:pass/:fail) matches §6. No field or semantic content appears dropped.
checks_performed.run1_spec_retained: PASS -- the single @spec block for run/1 (lines 305-307) is still present as a bare @spec, no def/body. Re-confirmed the distinction holds on a fresh look: a multi-line @spec/@type declaration cannot be pasted into a file and compiled as a working module on its own (it has no `def`, no `do...end`, nothing to execute), unlike the removed defmodule/defstruct blocks which were complete, loadable modules. This is the same line REQ-157's rework history already established for this session; no reason to move it.
checks_performed.list_groups_1_reverify: PASS -- independently re-read lib/letflow/identity.ex lines 500-537 directly (not the design's quoted excerpt). list_groups/1's real body is at lines 527-537 exactly as the design cites: `@spec list_groups(opts :: opts()) :: {:ok, %{groups: [Group.t()], total: non_neg_integer()}}` (527), `def list_groups(opts) do` (528), `prefix = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :prefix)` (529), `query = from(g in Group, order_by: [asc: g.name])` (531, no name/filter clause), `groups = Repo.all(query, prefix: prefix)` / `total = Repo.aggregate(Group, :count, prefix: prefix)` (533-534, unpaginated), `{:ok, %{groups: groups, total: total}}` (536). Confirms the design's claim verbatim: opts-only signature (prefix: only), no server-side name filter, full unpaginated list.
